name: Tikilla
look: a powerful ape with a huge white shaggy mane, a white skull face with a golden grin, bone stripes and enormous white fists carved like tiki masks
entry: Its fists have grown as big as tiki masks, and it carves faces into them to look fiercer. It leads its troop with thundering kicks and shakes its great white mane to warn rivals away.
how: Evolve Tikimp at level 32. It learns High Jump Kick when it evolves.
Wild: rare in jungles and on tropical islands.
